summary: Customer produces an opaque, concentrated milk product on a processing line; currently samples for fat and protein; wants earlier composition-change information via an initial spectroscopy concept and practical comparison experiment while retaining lab checks.

facts_stated.text: The product is an opaque, concentrated milk product.
The product flows through a processing line.
The customer currently samples for fat and protein analysis.
